question: As on November 2024, how many Khelo India Athletes received coaching, equipment, medical care, and Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **November 2024**, a total of **2781 Khelo India Athletes** have been provided with coaching, equipment, medical care, and Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA). This initiative is part of the **Khelo India Scheme** launched by the Government of India to promote sports at the grassroots level.
 
• The **Khelo India Scheme** focuses on identifying talented athletes across India and nurturing them through structured training programs, state-of-the-art facilities, and financial support.
 
• **Out of Pocket Allowance (OPA):** Each athlete under the scheme is given a monthly allowance of **₹10,000** to cover incidental expenses such as travel, diet, and other necessities related to their training and participation in sports events.
 
• The scheme has been instrumental in providing **holistic development** for athletes, ensuring they have access to world-class coaching and medical care to excel in national and international tournaments.
 
• This initiative aligns with the Government’s vision to make India a **global powerhouse in sports** by nurturing young talent and providing them with the necessary resources to succeed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Scheme:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India Program** was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in **2018** to revive India’s sports culture at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in the country.
 
• The scheme involves **talent identification**, training, and support for athletes under the age of 17 years across various disciplines.
 
• Under the initiative, athletes are selected through **Khelo India Games**, which include events such as the Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India University Games.
 
• Athletes chosen under this scheme receive **financial assistance of ₹5 lakh annually for eight years**, along with access to expert coaching and infrastructure support.
 
 
 
• **Components of the Scheme:**
 
 
• **Coaching:** Athletes are trained by top coaches to ensure skill enhancement and optimal performance in national and international competitions.
 
• **Equipment:** High-quality sports equipment is provided to athletes, ensuring they have access to the best tools to improve their performance.
 
• **Medical Care:** Comprehensive medical services, including physiotherapy and injury management, are offered to ensure athletes’ physical well-being.
 
• **Out of Pocket Allowance:** A monthly allowance of ₹10,000 is provided to cover incidental expenses.
 
 
 
• **Achievements Under the Scheme:**
 
 
• The program has successfully produced athletes who have represented India in prestigious events like the **Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games**.
 
• Notable athletes such as **Neeraj Chopra** and **Mirabai Chanu** have received support under this scheme and have achieved international acclaim.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**
 
 
• Athletes aged between **8-17 years** are eligible for selection under the Khelo India Scheme.
 
• The program covers athletes from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds, ensuring inclusivity and equal opportunity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Investment:** The Indian Government has allocated **₹1,756 crore** for the Khelo India Scheme for the years **2023-24** to ensure extensive outreach and development.
 
• **Infrastructure Development:** The program emphasizes the creation of sports infrastructure, including stadiums and training centers, across rural and urban regions to promote sports.
 
• **Global Recognition:** The scheme has improved India’s ranking in international sports, highlighting the importance of nurturing young talent.
 
• **Policy Alignment:** The Khelo India initiative aligns with the **National Sports Policy**, which aims to make sports an integral part of India’s culture and education system.

a7:T2e
